say:1:1910230001:1.text: Whoa, there's an even bigger cavern in here...
say:1:1910230001:1.source_cn: 咦？原来里面还有个这么大的洞窟呀……

say:2:1910230002:1.text: I can't even see the end of it... What do you think we'll find in there? Treasure, maybe?
say:2:1910230002:1.source_cn: 看不到尽头……里面会有什么呢？会不会有宝藏？

say:3:1910230003:1.text: Could there be some secret, uncharted area hidden inside? What if...
say:3:1910230003:1.source_cn: 这个海洞的深处会不会连通着从未被人发现的秘密区域？说不定……

say:4:1910230004:1.text: Hey, slow your roll! A giant sea monster could be lurking in there! Has that thought never crossed your mind?!
say:4:1910230004:1.source_cn: 停！里头万一是鱼怪的老巢怎么办？

say:5:1910230005:1.text: Know when to call it quits—that's the rule of thumb we fishermen live by. Venture too far, and you might never make it back.
say:5:1910230005:1.source_cn: 出海打渔有个规矩——适可而止。船划得太远，就回不来了。

choice_prompt:6:1910230005.text: Know when to call it quits—that's the rule of thumb we fishermen live by. Venture too far, and you might never make it back.
choice_prompt:6:1910230005.source_cn: 出海打渔有个规矩——适可而止。船划得太远，就回不来了。

say:7:1910230006:1.text: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
say:7:1910230006:1.male: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
say:7:1910230006:1.female: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!

say:8:1910230007:1.text: I've always had my head screwed on the right way!
say:8:1910230007:1.male: I've always had my head screwed on the right way!
say:8:1910230007:1.female: I've always had my head screwed on the right way!

say:9:1910230010:1.text: Fine... It's getting a little late anyway. Let's get back before Grandma starts worrying.
say:9:1910230010:1.source_cn: 好吧……今天的确太晚了，再不回去阿嬷要着急了。

say:10:1910230011:1.text: But I'm still dying to know what's inside the cave... Let's come back and explore another day.
say:10:1910230011:1.source_cn: 不过，我还是很好奇里面有什么……我们有空再来这里探险吧。

choice:6:0:1.text: It's not every day you say something so sensible.
choice:6:0:1.male: It's not every day you say something so sensible.
choice:6:0:1.female: It's not every day you say something so sensible.

say:13:1910230009:1.text: Uh-oh, Tolan looks like he's about to hit the roof! Guess he hates it when you copy the way he talks!
say:13:1910230009:1.source_cn: 图澜的情绪波动得好厉害！我猜他一定想说……别学他说话！

choice:6:2:3.text: Tolan's right. We should head back to Coralia first.
choice:6:2:3.source_cn: 他说得对，我们先回塔拉萨吧
choice:6:2:3.male: Tolan's right. We should head back to Coralia first.
choice:6:2:3.female: Tolan's right. We should head back to Coralia first.
